dbs.name: DBS Group Holdings
dbs.overview: DBS provides an annual sustainability report and separate disclosures on modern slavery and green bonds. These company publications are a starting point for reviewing its sustainability commitments and progress.

highlights.text: DBS published its 2025 Sustainability Report on 9 March 2026.

ocbc.name: OCBC
ocbc.overview: OCBC makes its 2025 Sustainability Report available through its official reporting library. Its sustainability resources also cover responsible business, community impact and the transition towards net zero.

highlights.text: The official reporting library includes the English-language 2025 Sustainability Report and an archive of earlier publications.
OCBC reports an S$80 billion committed sustainable finance portfolio in 2025. Its 2025 report uses 2024 financed-emissions data because client emissions reporting takes time.

uob.name: United Overseas Bank
uob.overview: UOB publishes group-level sustainability reporting covering its approach, objectives and performance. The report explains its reporting scope and where individual entities are excluded from particular disclosures.

highlights.text: The 2025 Sustainability Report covers 1 January–31 December 2025 and was published on 19 March 2026.

singtel.name: Singtel
singtel.overview: Singtel’s sustainability reporting covers environmental management, customers and suppliers, employees, and communities. Its FY2026 disclosures include data privacy, responsible procurement, workforce development and digital inclusion.

highlights.text: The FY2026 report covers the year ended 31 March 2026 and was issued on 30 June 2026. Selected disclosures received limited external assurance; that assurance does not cover every statement.

grab.name: Grab Holdings
grab.overview: Grab Holdings publishes ESG disclosures about partner livelihoods, platform safety, financial inclusion and environmental impact across its Southeast Asian businesses. These are issuer-reported results and commitments.

highlights.text: Grab reports that driver- and merchant-partners earned US$15.3 billion through its platform in 2025, up 19% year on year.
Its 2025 ESG report discusses access to finance, platform safety and carbon projects. Reported carbon credits should be distinguished from reductions in the company’s own gross emissions.

sea.name: Sea Limited
sea.overview: Sea’s official sustainability resources discuss access to digital services, small-business participation and communities served by its platforms. Its investor-relations site also provides annual reports and corporate governance information.

highlights.text: Sea describes its sustainability approach in terms of consumers, small businesses, local communities and employees across its digital ecosystem.

wilmar.name: Wilmar International
wilmar.overview: Wilmar publishes environmental, labour and supply-chain disclosures for its agribusiness operations. Its resource library includes responsible-sourcing policies, traceability updates, emissions data and grievance information.

highlights.text: Wilmar reports 2025 palm-oil traceability of 98.5% to mills and 90.0% to plantations.
The same disclosures report an 11.3% year-on-year increase in absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions in 2025. Renewable-energy initiatives and emissions outcomes should be reviewed together.

capitaland.name: CapitaLand Investment
capitaland.overview: CapitaLand Investment provides sustainability reports, case studies and related ESG publications through its investor-relations library. Use the reporting boundaries to distinguish group disclosures from the performance of individual properties and funds.

highlights.text: The official publications library lists a 2025 Sustainability Report alongside its annual reports and earlier sustainability publications.

aia.name: AIA Group
aia.overview: AIA’s sustainability strategy connects health, financial protection, responsible investment, operations and its workforce. Its official sustainability site provides the 2025 report and separate reports on its strategic priorities.

highlights.text: AIA states a commitment to net-zero emissions by 2050. This is a future target rather than a statement that net zero has already been achieved.

keppel.name: Keppel
keppel.overview: Keppel’s sustainability reporting describes its activities as an asset manager and operator, including climate-related disclosures and its climate transition plan. It distinguishes the operation of its own business from solutions offered to customers.

highlights.text: Keppel’s official reporting page links its 2025 Sustainability Report and describes an update to its Climate Transition Plan.

sembcorp.name: Sembcorp Industries
sembcorp.overview: Sembcorp provides sustainability and climate-related disclosures alongside its annual reporting. Its reporting resources allow users to examine its energy-transition strategy, commitments and operational performance.

highlights.text: Sembcorp’s official reporting library provides a 2025 Sustainability Report and separate 2025 Climate-related Disclosures.
The 2025 report records 15 GW of gross installed renewable capacity and one work-related contractor fatality. Its targets, reporting boundaries and safety outcomes should be read together.

documents.title: Sembcorp 2025 sustainability report – official annual-report edition

comfortdelgro.name: ComfortDelGro
comfortdelgro.overview: ComfortDelGro’s sustainability report covers transport emissions, passenger and employee safety, governance and innovation. Its emissions tables distinguish operational emissions from value-chain emissions.

highlights.text: For 2025, ComfortDelGro reports combined Scope 1 and market-based Scope 2 emissions 21.0% below its 2019 baseline, while Scope 3 emissions were 33.0% above that baseline.

thai_union.name: Thai Union Group
thai_union.overview: Thai Union’s SeaChange 2030 strategy covers seafood supply chains, human and labour rights, ocean health, climate action and circularity. Its sustainability reporting tracks progress against commitments rather than treating targets as completed outcomes.

highlights.text: SeaChange 2030 includes 11 interconnected goals. The company’s official resources provide its 2025 sustainability report, performance data and supporting policies.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA
nvidia.overview: NVIDIA’s sustainability resources cover the environmental footprint of computing, product energy efficiency and responsible business practices. Product-efficiency claims should be considered alongside manufacturing, supply-chain and operational impacts.

highlights.text: NVIDIA publishes a FY2026 Sustainability Report and product carbon footprints. Its sustainability site says those footprints follow ISO 14067:2018 and have third-party verification.

exxonmobil.business_summary: ExxonMobil produces oil and gas and manufactures fuels, lubricants and chemicals. Its climate report presents company claims; production-linked emissions provide a different view of impact.
exxonmobil.identity_note: The current XOM SEC filing entity is ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation. Earlier climate reports and Carbon Majors estimates refer to the ExxonMobil group; verify the corporate boundary.

shell.overview: Shell operates oil, gas, LNG, fuels and energy businesses. Its annual report includes sustainability statements; operational reductions and downstream product emissions have different boundaries.
shell.business_summary: Shell operates oil, gas, LNG, fuels and energy businesses. Its annual report includes sustainability statements; operational reductions and downstream product emissions have different boundaries.

chevron.overview: Chevron is an integrated oil and gas company. Review its company-reported environmental indicators alongside production and independently attributed emissions.
chevron.business_summary: Chevron is an integrated oil and gas company. Review its company-reported environmental indicators alongside production and independently attributed emissions.

highlights.text: Chevron publishes group sustainability highlights and environmental data. Automated access to its reports may be restricted; open the original to review the full tables and reporting boundaries.

totalenergies.overview: TotalEnergies operates oil, gas, LNG and electricity businesses. Its climate progress report includes energy-transition claims that should be read alongside production and absolute emissions.
totalenergies.business_summary: TotalEnergies operates oil, gas, LNG and electricity businesses. Its climate progress report includes energy-transition claims that should be read alongside production and absolute emissions.
